evidence.title: Wire authorized Event Search Inspector browser to existing Go HTTP host
evidence.goal: Make the existing CAP-INV-002 Search result -> CAP-INV-004 Inspector -> same Search window traversal use a real same-origin HTTP POST to the existing host with negative authorization tests against a live loopback-only synthetic Go server, without claiming real IAM, provider, or production deployment.
outputs: Actual Node fetch POST to live first-party Go HTTP host after Search controller selection
Go synthetic host uses independently-scoped Search and Telemetry owners, server bearer required only in test
Read-only browser inspection shows separate rendered/raw state and returns to same Search result window
Exact-HEAD CI: complete original JS tests, Go host tests, real local cross-language e2e, mandatory engineering checks
Explicit handoff and prior source blob provenance
acceptance_tests: Search controller selected Event uses the actual HTTP host and produces validated Inspector projection
Rendered authorized while raw and raw-derived are denied, and source/parser/enrichment provenance survives HTTP
Return restores same authorized Search result-window object after HTTP round trip
Wrong bearer/wrong tenant/foreign event deny and return no classified bytes
Bad Content-Type and >2 MiB response reject before browser displays result
Node24 and Go 1.26.8 tests run on exact CI SHA without real IAM/provider/API payante

rules: Canonical behavior: CAP-INV-002 Event Search -> CAP-INV-004 Event Inspection -> return. Shared owns Telemetry Event and Search Job, Settings owns Parser and Data Source. No product source of truth was edited.

Engineering parent: existing E10-INV-004; child H depends on E10-INV-004G-HOST (IMPLEMENTED at source SHA, not merged) and E10-INV-002G (VERIFIED on #36). Git parent = PR #184 branch, not the business owner. Bridge code owner = existing frontend and Go host test fixture; no new production runtime owner.

Immutable provenance: original frontend inspection.mjs and inspection.test.mjs, plus existing package baseline and README, copied by *identical blob IDs* from draft PR #183 SHA bc66d3b1e4161cd5de45b0346d326174712b20d2 onto the separate new branch based on PR #184 SHA 239ad0950f35a283e8611baf599a652966822dcb. Neither source branch was mutated. Package script then extended to exercise bridge test.

Functional increment: inspection-http.mjs provides a fixed same-origin JSON POST to the *existing* host /investigate/event-inspection, using browser credentials, abort signal, no-store, redirect rejection, strict JSON/UTF-8 parsing and <=2 MiB streaming body. Existing frontend Journey already verifies selected Event/job/run/correlation, cancels stale requests, renders textContent-only and returns to exact authorized window. No second Project engine.
